title: Vincere Biobank Research Protocol
summary: The Vincere Biobank aims to make quality biospecimens and associated clinical data available for research studies related to advancing medicine and improving care for patients, including cancer screening, treatment, and care.
criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* 18 years of age or older; any gender
* Able to donate a blood, urine, tissue, and/or other biospecimen sample
* Able to provide informed consent to participate in the study

Exclusion Criteria:

* Minors, under the age of 18 years
* Individuals who lack the capacity to give informed consent
